name: Arcane Feedback
notes:
Casting the empowered spell consumes the bonus. Spell costs do not generate feedback. Damage scaling, the bonus cap and how multiple hits contribute are left for tuning.

In game (hwp_sor_lm_arcane_feedback, tested): mana lost to enemy damage is banked up to the cap; the next spell takes it for +0.5% damage per point for 3 s (both assumed).
summary: Taking enemy damage empowers your next spell based on the mana you lost, up to a cap.
